_why: Destin, theme-cards-review TC-1: previews should be screenshots of the theme in a window, and the framed-picture card with a much thinner strip. Scope and contents chosen in chat 2026-09-24: built-in + community now, whole window.
title: Theme previews — real screenshots, and the slimmer card

steps.path: Appearance cards, Marketplace cards and theme pages
steps.headline: Every built-in and community theme's preview is now a screenshot of the real app in that theme.
steps.changed: Before, each preview was a drawn mock page with a 'Theme Preview' badge. Now it's the actual app window in that theme: the real header, a short sample conversation, the message box and the status bar, with wallpaper, glass and mascots as they really look. Order: Light, Dark, Midnight, Crème, then the 8 community themes.
steps.notice: The same pictures show on the Marketplace cards and theme pages, not only in Appearance.
steps.risk: The community pictures reach the Marketplace only after the themes library update is merged. Themes you build yourself still get the old drawn preview; that's filed on the roadmap.

steps.headline: The card is the framed picture, with a much thinner strip under it for the name and star.
steps.changed: The picture now fills most of the card at the preview's own shape, so almost the whole window shows. The strip beneath is one small line: the name, 'Active' when it's the current theme, and the star (plus the pencil on themes you built).
steps.notice: Community themes installed on your computer now show a picture too. Installing a theme never downloaded its preview, so those cards used to show only a colour gradient; they now borrow the theme library's copy.
steps.risk: Halftone Dimension here still shows its OLD drawn preview: the library's copy updates only when its change merges.
